description: gen_bindings.py drops (1) Result<(), E> because rustdoc encodes () as an empty tuple the tuple branch rejects -- this kills step()/run()/solve_timestep() workspace-wide; (2) Arc<T>/Rc<T>, so PimpleFoam::new(mesh: Arc<FvMesh>, ..) is unconstructible; (3) type aliases of generic types, so VolScalarField = VolField<f64> and the other field types are absent entirely. Needs alias-substitution: map the generic struct's type params to the alias's concrete args and emit inherent impls under that substitution. gh:#3 https://github.com/theodoreOnzGit/outram-park/issues/3 . Related backend issue bn:op-b4dd (lift outram-foam CLI case glue into a lib).
title: codegen: three type-mapping gaps block every solver API from reaching Python
